metadata.title: Monge's transport problem in synthetic Lorentzian spacetimes
metadata.abstract: We prove the existence of solutions to the Lorentzian Monge problem on synthetic Lorentzian spacetimes that satisfy the forward timelike measure contraction property $TMCP^+(K,N)$. The cost for this problem is the time separation function $\ell(x,y)$ (the Lorentz distance), which represents the maximum amount a particle can age when traveling from $x$ to $y$. The solution is based on the needle decomposition technique, and amounts to a reduction of the full problem to its one-dimensional counterparts. As an application of needle decomposition, we show that the Lorentzian timelike measure contraction property $TMCP^+(K,N)$ is equivalent to the $TMCP^+_{rLip}(K,N)$ condition, where the curvature dimension conditions are defined on gradient flow curves of reverse 1-Lipschitz functions.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 在满足向前类时测度收缩条件 TMCP⁺(K,N) 的合成 Lorentz 时空中，证明以时间分离函数为代价的 Monge 问题存在解，并证明两种 TMCP 表述等价。
analysis.breakthrough: 将 Lorentz 输运存在性与合成曲率条件连接到可处理的一维问题。
analysis.limitations: 摘要未列出全部测度和因果假设；不能直接推广到任意 Lorentz 时空或所有输运代价。 已补读引言及第5–6页定理1.1与构造思路；需全局双曲、适当本质不分支、源测度绝对连续及类时分离等条件，不能只保留 TMCP 一项。 未逐行审读完整证明。 AI 披露另见独立全文检索及命中核查记录；未见披露不代表未使用 AI。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: 合成曲率、测度分解和最优输运高度相关，方法复用潜力大。
